summary: Full audit of role administrador_igss (igss.admin / IgssAdmin2024$). I ran 32 API checks (26 pass, 6 fail) and drove the UI with Playwright: login, every sidebar item, about 20 URLs entered directly, and the visible action buttons. Login works and lands on /pacientes, not on /sala-operaciones as test_credentials.md says. Sidebar seen: Pacientes, Evaluación Oftalmológica, Agenda, Sala de Operaciones group (Cirugías, Insumos y Equipos Qx, Proced. de Anestesia), IGSS group (Unidades IGSS, NOG). Óptica/Accesorios does not appear because the role lacks view_optica. Core IGSS features work: Pacientes, Unidades IGSS CRUD, NOG and Evaluación. Several suspicions in the review request turned out WRONG: GET /api/surgeries requires only authentication, so Cirugías loads the FULL surgery list of every institution. The Anestesia page does not fail: it hides the Cierre tab by role and shows only Tipos de anestesia, read-only. Real defects found: the Agenda menu item silently redirects to /pacientes; patient Excel and PDF export return 500 for this role (KeyError record_number); there are visible buttons that fail with 403 (Plantilla Excel in Sala, Agregar/Editar insumo). The worst problem is a permission leak: Cuentas por Cobrar (clinic + óptica financial data) and CRM Cirugías are fully readable by this role through a URL typed directly into the address bar, and the CxC write endpoints (abono/anular/crear) only check authentication.
landing_after_login: /pacientes (ProtectedRoute defaultPage for any role other than superadmin/anestesia). test_credentials.md is outdated: it says /sala-operaciones.
sidebar_observed: nav-sala-operaciones-group > nav-sala-operaciones Cirugías, nav-quirofano-insumos Insumos y Equipos Qx, nav-quirofano-anestesia Proced. de Anestesia
nav-igss > nav-unidades-igss Unidades IGSS, nav-gestion-nog NOG

menu_item_results.Pacientes: OK – the list loads (17,904 patients, ALL institutions incl. Particular, not only IGSS). Excel, PDF, Plantilla and Nuevo Paciente buttons are visible. The Nuevo Paciente dialog opens. Create→edit→search via API OK. Excel/PDF export return 500 (opened in a new tab, which shows 'Internal Server Error').
menu_item_results.Evaluación Oftalmológica: OK – the full editor loads with no API errors
menu_item_results.Agenda: BROKEN – a click silently redirects to /pacientes. The /agenda route requires the view_agenda permission, which the role does not have, yet the menu item is shown because menu 'agenda' is enabled. (Backend GET /api/agenda/citas returns 200 for any authenticated user.)
menu_item_results.Cirugías (/sala-operaciones): Loads the FULL list (Seguro Privado, Novavision, IGSS…) with no error: GET /api/surgeries and /surgeries/options only need authentication. The detail dialog opens (read-only). 'Plantilla Excel' gives toast 'Error al descargar la plantilla' (403 GET surgeries/template, needs view_sala_operaciones). Write endpoints are protected (manage_sala_operaciones).
menu_item_results.Insumos y Equipos Qx: Loads read-only, but the Agregar, Editar (pencil) and activate/deactivate (power) buttons are visible. Agregar→Guardar shows toast "Se requiere rol ['admin', 'superadmin'] para esta acción" (403 POST /api/quirofano/catalog).
menu_item_results.Proced. de Anestesia: Loads with no error. The frontend hides the 'Cierre mensual' tab (canSeeCierre role check) and shows only 'Tipos de anestesia', read-only. No 403 fires in the UI. The backend closure endpoint returns 403 as expected. The review's suspicion of a blank screen or error is NOT confirmed.
menu_item_results.Unidades IGSS: OK – list, alerts, Catálogo/Producción tabs load. API create/update/get/delete of a TEST_ unit and GET nogs all return 200. The Mantenimiento endpoint is allowed (MANTENIMIENTO_ROLES includes administrador_igss).
menu_item_results.NOG: OK – the list of 83 NOG and the totals load, and the Nuevo NOG button is visible. I did not create a NOG through the UI.

LEAKS_real_data_shown: /cuentas-cobrar-finanzas – full clinic CxC: totals Q16,470.40, 21 accounts, responsables tab (GET /api/cuentas-cobrar/clinica 200; /optica 200 as well)
route_open_but_backend_403_shell_with_er: /configuracion/proveedores (toast 'Error al cargar los proveedores', 403 GET suppliers)

critical.issue: These endpoints only use Depends(get_current_user), with no role or permission check. administrador_igss (and any authenticated role) can read the full CxC financial data and, per the code, register payments, void accounts and create or delete responsables. I verified the GETs live and did NOT run the writes, to avoid changing real data.

Only get_current_user, so the full surgery list of every institution is exposed to IGSS admin. Add require_permission('view_sala_operaciones'), or filter to IGSS patients if the role should see only IGSS surgeries.

500 KeyError 'record_number' at routes/patients.py lines 1113 and 1201 (some patient documents lack record_number). This breaks the Excel/PDF buttons for EVERY role, not only IGSS. Use enriched.get('record_number','').

minor.issue: Readable by administrador_igss (requires only view_patients or auth)
200 for any authenticated user, while the frontend route requires view_agenda (inconsistent)
require_role(['admin','superadmin']) although the role has import_patients=true, so this permission is unusable. POST /api/patients/import is a 501 placeholder.
Open to any authenticated user (anesthesia records include patient names)

ui_bugs.issue: Shown because isMenuEnabled('agenda') is true, but the /agenda route requires view_agenda, so a click silently bounces to /pacientes
window.open shows 'Internal Server Error' (backend 500) and the UI gives no feedback
The Agregar, Editar and activate/deactivate buttons are shown to non-admin roles; saving fails with a 403 toast
The 'Plantilla Excel' button is shown without view_sala_operaciones and gives toast 'Error al descargar la plantilla' (403)

integration_issues.issue: /cuentas-cobrar-finanzas, /crm-cirugias, /configuracion/proveedores, /gastos and /punto-venta have no requiredPermission or role, and /inventario has none for this role. Any role can open them by URL: two show real data, the others show error shells.

action_items: Decide the scope of Sala de Operaciones, Insumos and Anestesia for administrador_igss. If out of scope, remove sala_operaciones, quirofano_insumos and quirofano_anestesia (and optica_accesorios, which is useless) from db.menu_configurations for this role. If in scope, grant view_sala_operaciones.
Agenda: either grant view_agenda to the role or remove 'agenda' from its enabled menus. Also gate the nav item with hasPermission('view_agenda') in Layout.js.
Secure /api/cuentas-cobrar/* (read AND write) with proper permissions (e.g. manage_caja/manage_sales), and add a requiredPermission on the /cuentas-cobrar-finanzas route.
Add a permission check to GET /api/surgeries and /surgeries/options (view_sala_operaciones).
Gate the /crm-cirugias, /gastos, /punto-venta, /configuracion/proveedores and /inventario routes with requiredPermission/requiredMenu.
Fix the KeyError 'record_number' in export_patients_excel (line 1113) and export_patients_pdf (line 1201) with .get().
Hide the Insumos Agregar/Editar/toggle buttons and the Sala 'Plantilla Excel' button for roles without permission.
Align patients import: the role has import_patients, but the import endpoints require the admin role.
Clarify whether IGSS admin should see only IGSS patients: the list currently shows all 17,904, including Particular.
Update test_credentials.md: landing page is /pacientes, and the menus include quirofano_insumos, quirofano_anestesia and optica_accesorios.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js builds the Agenda, Cirugías, Insumos and Anestesia items from isMenuEnabled only, while App.js guards /agenda with requiredPermission='view_agenda'. Menu config and the route guard disagree.
Many backend routers rely on get_current_user only (cuentas_cobrar.py, surgeries list, quirofano catalog/records, agenda citas). Authorization is enforced inconsistently.

ProcedimientosAnestesia.js and InsumosEquiposQuirurgicos.js hardcode role lists (['admin','superadmin','anestesia']) instead of permissions. Anestesia hides UI correctly; Insumos does not hide its buttons.
Pacientes export uses window.open, so the user gets no error feedback on a backend failure.

success_rate.backend: 81% (26/32; the 6 failures are real defects: 2× export 500, import template 403, 3× permission leaks)
success_rate.frontend: 6 of the 8 menu items work as intended for the role (Agenda broken, Cirugías over-exposes data); direct URL blocking 14/20 correct, 2 data leaks

seed_data_creation: Created and removed: 1 TEST_UNIDAD_* IGSS unit (deleted), 1 TEST_Igss Audit* patient (soft-deleted via superadmin). No other data changed. The POST of the insumo TEST_igss_insumo was rejected with 403, so nothing was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/test_igss_admin_role_audit.py (one login per module; login is rate-limited to 5/min). After fixes, the BLOCKED list should pass, ALLOWED export excel/pdf should return 200, and nav-agenda should either be gone or open /agenda. The browser_automation tool rewrites screenshot paths: use plain names without expressions.
